why: Pages this gate CANNOT examine, each with the reason and the condition that removes it. A page listed here leaves the DENOMINATOR, so the run can be conclusive about what it did examine instead of INCONCLUSIVE for ever about what it could not. It is a stated exclusion, never a permanent one: `unexaminable.test.ts` requires every entry to carry both `reason` and `removedWhen`, and `check-real-page-findings.ts` PRINTS every entry on every run, so an exclusion cannot sit here unread. An unusable page that is NOT listed here still makes the run inconclusive -- which is what stops this file becoming a way to launder a failure into a pass.

https://tfl.gov.uk/modes/tube/.reason: The site redirects: the capture landed on https://tfl.gov.uk/tube-dlr-overground/status/#windrush, not the requested URL, so no CDP target could be confirmed as the page and the census reads as ABSENT to every rule. Its consent banner also blocks the read-through, which is a second, independent reason and the only page where that is still true.
https://tfl.gov.uk/modes/tube/.removedWhen: `sameDocument` can tell a REDIRECT from a genuinely different document -- see the agent/same-document-redirect design. Scheduled to ride the next capture-path change rather than costing its own recapture.

https://www.w3.org/WAI/demos/bad/after/s.reason: The site rewrites its own extension: the capture landed on survey.php, not the requested survey.html. It IS the requested page, under a URL `sameDocument` cannot recognise as the same document, so the census is refused.
https://www.w3.org/WAI/demos/bad/after/s.removedWhen: The same `sameDocument` fix. This page is the cheapest possible test of it: same document, different extension, no redirect chain.
